# tuning anchor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tuningAnchor`](gmeow-tuningAnchor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tuningAnchor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

Relates a [`TuningSystem`](../classes/gmeow-TuningSystem.md) to one of its PitchAnchors (e.g., A440 vs A415). Non-functional: a [`TuningSystem`](../classes/gmeow-TuningSystem.md) may be anchored differently in different performances or historical periods, and competing anchors may coexist as standpoint-indexed claims ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TuningSystem`](../classes/gmeow-TuningSystem.md) -> [`gmeow:PitchAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-PitchAnchor.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tuningAnchor`](gmeow-tuningAnchor.md) from [`gmeow:TuningSystem`](../classes/gmeow-TuningSystem.md) to [`gmeow:PitchAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-PitchAnchor.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms
